antipattern.code:
# 评审人: gemini-code-assist[bot] (critical)
# 尾随逗号导致属性被初始化为 tuple 而非标量值
# self.hidden_size 变为 (hidden_size,) 而非 hidden_size
# 导致 forward_oot 中 tp_size 乘法运算 TypeError

class AscendMultiHeadLatentAttention(nn.Module):
    """Ascend Multi-Head Latent Attention implementation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        hidden_size: int,
        enable_shared_expert_dp: bool,
        debug_layer_idx: int,
        first_k_dense_replace: int,
        tp_size: int,
        ...
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # 尾随逗号导致属性变为 tuple 类型
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size,
        self.enable_shared_expert_dp = enable_shared_expert_dp,
        self.debug_layer_idx = debug_layer_idx,
        self.first_k_dense_replace = first_k_dense_replace,
        self.tp_size = tp_size,
        # 后续初始化...
        self.num_heads = hidden_size // self.head_dim
